title: Signal: conda environment mixes pip installs into the solver's tree
scope: A environment.yml file that declares a `pip` entry in the conda dependency list, which lets pip install outside the solver.
limitations: It matches a `pip` entry in the conda dependency list, which lets pip install outside the solver in the parsed environment.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A environment.yml that mentions a `pip` entry in the conda dependency list, which lets pip install outside the solver in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
